description: A3 task 5b-1 (F3; #739): AMRAP scoring, timed completion choices and effort, wired through Round 7’s owners on /workout — TimedWorkoutFlow (src/ui/timed-workout-flow.tsx) with its one “Log results” LoggingOverlay, and inside it TimedResultLog (src/ui/timed-result-log.tsx), QuantitySelector (src/ui/quantity-selector.tsx) and SetEffortChoice (src/ui/set-effort.tsx). check-01 owns src/ui/set-effort.test.tsx whole (owner decision 3, 2026-11-18): the set’s three faces and, for the timed log, the always-named Clear and a saved answer shown disabled (TASK-010). check-02 runs only this task’s four TASK-009 blank/zero cases of src/ui/amrap-block.test.tsx (TASK-110 owns that file), carried from the old build (181e580) onto the AMRAP the route draws (BlockSlot under the product presentation), in place of the base cases they supersede. parity compares /workout’s AMRAP, For Time and ladder with the accepted gallery states amrap, for_time and ladder (bec4454) at 320 and 390 px: before Start, the log past the cap, the same log answered on both sides, and the card behind it, in words and element boxes; captures go to the evidence store under clear-gallery-adoption-v2-20261118/task-116/captures. The carried TASK-009 and TASK-010 checks (src/ui/timed-result-log.test.tsx, e2e/refinement/task-009.spec.ts, task-010.spec.ts) prove the route behaviour and the save authority (TASK-AC-8FF68F3F5241). Every declared case must execute and pass.

check-01.command: node scripts/refinement/run-required-check.mjs --task TASK-116 --check check-01 -- npx vitest run src/ui/set-effort.test.tsx --passWithNoTests=false
